Allows applications to customize or enrich the Announcement data returned by AESAnnouncementService. 
Implementations receive the standard AES Announcement object and must return the resulting Announcement object.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>AESAnnouncementExtension</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var AESTestAnnouncementExtension = Class.create();

AESTestAnnouncementExtension.prototype =
    Object.extendsObject(AESAnnouncementExtension, {

        transformAnnouncement: function(announcement, gr, options) {

            announcement.custom_field = "WORKED";

            return announcement;
        },

        type: 'AESTestAnnouncementExtension'
    });]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-23 20:36:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>6427014993af8790ef30f2918bba10ed</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>AESAnnouncementExtension</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Announcement Experience Suite" source="x_733168_aes">69255b1793db4b50ef30f2918bba10d5</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Announcement Experience Suite">69255b1793db4b50ef30f2918bba10d5</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_6427014993af8790ef30f2918bba10ed</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 20:37:54</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
